empty.filtered: no projects match the current filters

error.edges: must start and end with a letter or digit
error.pattern: letters, digits and single hyphens only

form.namePlaceholder: what this project is, in a few words
form.slugHint: Shown as a column in every list in the product. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
form.repoHint: Optional. Where this project's worker profiles are authored — leave it empty to run on the platform defaults.
form.iconHint: Optional. A single emoji or an image URL, shown beside the slug. Without one, the mark comes from the repository's host.
form.colorHint: Optional. Paints the dot beside the mark and tints the tags — never the interface.
form.tagsHint: Optional. What this project is — press Enter or comma to add each one, Backspace to remove the last.

create.title: New project
create.summary: A project owns its applications, its runs and its budget. The slug is the handle it is known by everywhere else.
create.failureTail: Nothing was created — what you typed is still exactly as you left it.
create.guardBody: The name, slug and repository you typed are not saved anywhere yet. Leaving this page drops them.

detail.notFoundDescription: The registry holds nothing under <id/>. A project id out of an old link is the ordinary way to arrive here — an address outlives the project it named, and the registry is where the ones that still exist are.
detail.rolesEmpty: Nobody holds a role on this project. Anyone who can reach it reaches it through a platform grant, which holds everywhere and is not listed here.

editor.iconHint: A single emoji or an image URL. Empty keeps the current mark.
editor.colorHint: Paints the dot beside the mark and tints the tags — never the interface.
editor.tagsHint: What this project is. Saving an empty list clears the tags.

handoff.runsNote: open the duty list narrowed to this project
handoff.queueNote: open the claim queue narrowed to this project
handoff.sourcesNote: open the intake narrowed to this project
handoff.costNote: the figure is this project's — the report behind it is the platform's

jobs.emptyTitle: Nothing runs here on a clock
jobs.emptyDescription: No schedule starts work on this project on its own. Everything that runs here was filed or dispatched by a person.
jobs.dialogDescription: A cron entry the platform files on this project by itself — the brief becomes the ticket, the profile becomes the first step.
jobs.cronHint: Five-field cron, in the project's own timezone policy. Pick a preset or compose the wire directly.
jobs.profileHint: The work-item profile the run starts from — the catalog lives in the client's git.
jobs.briefHint: Stored verbatim. Nothing between this box and the host touches it.
jobs.deleteBody: <cron/> for <profile/> stops firing and is removed. Work already running because of it is not touched.
